topic: You do not need to have it all figured out

slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Direction aksar move karne ke baad clear hoti hai, pehle nahi.
Har possibility predict karne ki koshish start ko unnecessarily delay kar deti hai.
Tumhe poori staircase nahi dekhni. Bas agla safe aur useful step enough hai.
Uncertainty ka matlab stop nahi hota. Learn karte hue direction adjust ki ja sakti hai.
Ek priority likho, uska first action decide karo aur aaj hi usse start karo.
Tum lost nahi ho. Tum process me ho—aur process action se hi clear hota hai.

caption:
Life ka poora map pehle nahi milta. Kabhi-kabhi pehla step lene ke baad hi next direction samajh aati hai.

Aaj sab solve karne ki zaroorat nahi—bas ek useful next step lo.
